b. ANCHOR- Racing Heart:

i. Common: anxiety, substance intoxication or withdrawals ii. Deadly: arrhythmia iii. Exotic: hyperthyroidism, pheochromocytoma

c. ANCHOR- Tremor:

i. Common: benign tremors, substance induced ii. Deadly: alcohol withdrawal iii. Exotic: hyperthyroidism

d. ANCHOR- Elevated Liver associated Enzymes:

i. Common: drugs, steatohepatitis
